faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q_payment: Which payment methods do you accept?
faq.a_paymentCredit: Credit card (VISA / MasterCard / JCB, Apple Pay supported): pay online straight away. Payments are processed and encrypted by ECPay, a third-party payment provider.
faq.a_paymentEcpayOffline: ATM transfer or convenience-store payment code / barcode: you receive the payment details after ordering — please pay before the deadline.
faq.a_paymentBank: Bank transfer: our account details are provided after you order. Please transfer within {days} days.
faq.a_paymentCod: Cash on delivery: pay when you collect the parcel.
faq.a_paymentTail: Orders not paid by the deadline are cancelled automatically.
faq.q_bank: What do I do after making a bank transfer?
faq.a_bank: The account details appear on your order page and in the confirmation email. Any interbank transfer fee is paid by the buyer. Once you have transferred, send us your order number, the amount, the transfer date and the last five digits of your account through our official LINE account, and we will arrange shipping as soon as the payment is confirmed. Please transfer within {days} days — orders not paid in time are cancelled automatically.
faq.q_coupon: How do I use a coupon code?
faq.a_coupon: Enter it in the “Coupon code” field on the cart page and press Apply — the discount is reflected in the total straight away. Each code has its own minimum spend and usage limit, and only one code can be used per order.
faq.a_fee: Convenience store pickup is {cvs} and home delivery is {home}. Orders over {threshold} ship free.
faq.a_feeHomeOnly: Home delivery is {home}. Orders over {threshold} ship free.
faq.q_home: What should I know about home delivery (T-Cat)?
faq.a_home: If a parcel is returned for personal reasons after it ships — for example it is refused, the recipient cannot be reached, or delivery is not signed for — it is recorded as unclaimed/returned, and a single such record ends your ability to place further orders.
faq.q_cvs: Which convenience stores can I collect from, and how long do I have?
faq.a_cvs: 7-ELEVEN and FamilyMart. Choose store pickup at checkout and a store map opens so you can pick a branch. When the parcel arrives you are notified by SMS or email — please collect it within 7 days. Parcels not collected in time are returned and recorded as unclaimed, and a single such record ends your ability to place further orders.
faq.a_established: An order is confirmed once payment is complete and has been received, and timing is counted from that day (this applies to credit card, ATM / convenience-store payment and bank transfer).
faq.a_dispatch: In-stock items ship within about 2–3 business days of the order being confirmed (excluding weekends and holidays; actual timing depends on order volume and courier conditions). We email you when it ships, and you can follow the delivery under My Account → Orders.
faq.q_preorder: Are items in stock or pre-order?
faq.a_preorder: Over 70% of our items are in stock. When something sells out we may reopen it for pre-order depending on the item, and it is marked “Pre-order” on the product page and in your cart. Pre-order items ship about 10–20 business days after the order is confirmed (excluding weekends and holidays; it depends on the brand’s production and delivery). If an order contains a pre-order item, everything ships together once all items have arrived. For questions about arrival dates or item condition, message us on our official LINE account.
faq.a_invoice: Invoices are issued on paper and shipped with your parcel; if you need a company tax ID (three-copy invoice), enter it at checkout. Once payment completes we also email an electronic receipt — note this receipt is not a uniform invoice and cannot be used for tax filing.
faq.q_cancel: Can I cancel or change my order?
faq.a_cancel: Please check the style, colour and size of every item before ordering. Placing an order means you accept our shopping terms, and orders cannot be cancelled once confirmed. Paid orders cannot be changed or combined, so please check your order before paying.
faq.q_unpaid: How long do I have to pay?
faq.a_unpaid: Please pay by the deadline shown on your order page; unpaid orders are cancelled automatically. Accounts that repeatedly leave orders unpaid, cancel at will or return items without reason may be suspended and blocked from future purchases.
faq.q_supply: What happens if an item becomes unavailable?
faq.a_supply: If supply of an item changes, we will contact you and handle it from there. For any question about your order, payment or shipping, message us on our official LINE account.
faq.q_contact: Who do I contact about an order or after-sales issue?
faq.a_contact: For anything about an order, after-sales service or a return, please message our official LINE account first — we will look into it right away.
faq.q_returns: Can I return or exchange an item?
faq.a_returns: Under Taiwan’s Consumer Protection Act, online purchases can be cancelled within 7 days starting the day after delivery. This is an inspection period, not a trial period — returned items must be complete with their tags and packaging. For hygiene reasons, sleepwear and other intimate apparel cannot be returned or exchanged once opened, tried on or de-tagged.
faq.q_defect: What if my item is faulty or wrong?
faq.a_defect: Message our official LINE account as soon as possible with photos and we will sort it out. Where we are at fault, we cover shipping both ways.
faq.a_refund: Refunds and returns are handled through our official LINE account. Once we receive the returned item and check it, refunds are processed within 3–7 business days. Card refunds follow your issuer, usually 1–2 billing cycles; other payment methods are refunded by bank transfer to the account you specify.
